items.text: The phone's plain 'start' (remote watcher, kind start) goes straight to scheduler.requestStart and skips POST /sessions' other refusals: nothing runnable, a budget above the month's cap, the one-wait rule. Only the refused-credential check runs first (added in L4i).
items.evidence: Sources: L4i #7, #10 (first half), routing never_cut[0]. At c15d75e packages/runtime/src/remote/watcher.ts:779-801 runStart parses StartParams, asks deps.startRefused (refused credential only, fixup 84f9e7e), calls kill.resume(), then deps.start; compose.ts:6058 wires start: (req) => scheduler.requestStart(req). POST /sessions (server.ts:1979ff) runs wakeLimitWaits, the Continue rest, removedProjectRefusal, refuseOverMonth, startBlocked 'nothing_runnable' and the kept-start/one-wait checks before it asks the scheduler. None of the 16 wave 8 areas planned on 2026-11-02 names remote/watcher.ts in its files.
items.reason: Money rule: a start the Start dialog and POST /sessions refuse (above the month's cap, nothing to run, a second wait) still runs from the phone. Phase H (the phone), never cut. If the re-planned collab-claims (one person's own devices: desktop, phone, cloud runner through the state service) changes remote/watcher.ts, it takes this instead. Fix shape: one start check shared by POST /sessions and the remote start; a phone-row case that fails with the refusal's sentence, plus a real-daemon case. The other half of #10 (kill.resume before the refusal) and the missing phone-row test were fixed in 84f9e7e.

items.text: W15-01's sole-linked rule: an unmarked open fr/docs-scaffold (or fr/status) pull request of another project counts as this project's own when this project is the only one on this install linked to the repository, so the scaffold, Try again and the status writer write onto it.
items.evidence: Sources: L4i #55, #65, routing never_cut[1]. packages/runtime/src/loop/docs.ts:236-247 isProjectDocsPr: a scaffold PR with no recorded pr_url, no hidden mark and no 'Forerunner project X.' line returns opts.soleLinked; :259-267 isProjectStatusPr does the same for fr/status; ownsUnmarkedDocs (:280-299) is true when this install's RepositoryIndex lists only this project for the repository. Callers: the scaffold write (:925-931), the status write (:1155-1160), the Overview listing (daemon/pull-requests.ts:411-416, :514). A together project is safe (isTogether returns false first). The L4i real-daemon Try again case wrote onto fr/docs-scaffold until Sandbox's PR body was marked.
items.reason: Breaks wave 8's 'Never' rule (no write to another Forerunner's pull request). Another Forerunner's project is never in this install's index, so any non-together project here is always 'sole linked': an unmarked scaffold or status PR that the other Forerunner, a person or an older version opened is written onto. It fails open today. Fix: an unmarked PR is this project's only when this install recorded or opened it; otherwise it is nobody's (fails closed). Test with two composed homes against one stand-in GitHub (brief section 9). Area: repo-guide (the scaffold writer) in wave 8's first group; the fr/status half goes with status-issue-write, which replaces the status pull request.

items.text: UpdatesPage sends `me?.id ?? "human"` as the answer's author: a press on the model-watch report before /me has loaded answers as 'human'. e2e/updates.spec.ts failed once on this race (expected 'human_alice'), then passed 3 of 3.
items.evidence: Sources: L4i #32, #44, routing early[0], merge problems_left. apps/ui/src/pages/UpdatesPage.tsx:136 `const by = me?.id ?? "human";` is unchanged at c15d75e; apps/ui/e2e/updates.spec.ts:31-40 expects by 'human_alice'.
items.reason: Early: wave 8's first group. It is a flaky Playwright source that would slow every wave 8 merge, and the answer goes to the wrong person (attribution). Fix: keep the press off until /me has loaded (or let the daemon fill in its own person), with a UI test that holds /me back. Small.

items.text: Chat's task_create acts at once at every level, also at Assisted when the task's description is in the model's own words, not the person's (L4h-left-6 rest).
items.evidence: Sources: L4i #29, #33, #38, #49, routing decided[0]. packages/commands/src/executor.ts:557-559 ('task.create acts at once when the person says it'); the docs/decisions/0119 amendment of 2026-11-24 (:311-318) leaves it 'Not changed, for the session lead'. No read-back depends on whose words the description is. The test of whose words a note is, notesPersons/saidInLine (packages/commands/src/commands/shared.ts), exists since d7bcaed.
items.reason: Decided by the L4h-left-1 rule (session lead, 2026-11-24): a description whose words are in the person's own message is the person's and acts at once; one the model wrote is read back first. To build: task.create in a chat or voice turn uses notesPersons on the description (and the title) to choose between acting and reading back. Add commands and real-daemon cases for both, and replace the ADR 0119 'Not changed' paragraph with the decision. Small, attribution.

items.text: take-over-retry sorts its failure by a guess that can say something untrue: 'blocked' ('another project's docs pull request is open ... close it on GitHub') whenever no PR URL came back and the branch is fr/docs-scaffold or absent, even when no pull request is open; any thrown error, GitHub not answering included, reads 'check that the saved GitHub token can push'.
